applications.claim: Produce MetricSections for the actual discriminant-210 PEL surface at every admissible rational contact point.

obligations.required: Indefinite quaternion algebra, maximal order, determinant condition, the stated principal polarization, actual universal abelian surface and level U.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: V11 names these objects and uses maximal U (n(U)=1) for the integral comparison.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: The translation theorem has exactly this moduli setting; same-object identification of the constructed contact normalization with that stack is not supplied by the elliptic Hodge packet.

obligations.required: Actual maximal regular semistable stack, its dualizing square, Hodge determinant and evaluated integral sections.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: Actual relative Ω and five local frames on the contact normalization; separate actual Weierstrass Hodge evaluation isomorphism.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: These are useful geometric constructions but neither is a construction of the PEL surface/Hodge determinant, and the new tensor packet has only local sections.

obligations.required: All primitive u,v with all five contact forms nonzero, all number-field places and all needed components.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: RefinedGeometricRealization quantifies this exact domain; MetricSections quantifies every infinite and finite place.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: A constructor satisfying those quantified fields for the actual PEL fibers remains absent. No argument may replace all places by generic-fiber data.

obligations.required: The canonical determinant KS map, correct pullback from maximal level, and induced integral image lattice.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: InducedLattice318 derives degree from an equality of actual placewise frame norms.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: Need identify the map and lattices before using the scalar conclusion; an abstract/rational line isomorphism cannot supply ks_image.

obligations.required: The contact curve and bicanonical sections must be those pulled back from the same maximal stack whose abelian fiber has the stated height.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: The scalar consumer accepts two coordinates and two FrameNorms records.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: Those records do not themselves encode a scheme or a universal abelian surface. An external construction-to-record interpretation is required.

obligations.required: Petersson norm 2 Im τ; surface Hodge squared norm (2π)^−2 integral; image 210·ω² with induced metric.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: The freshly checked translation and the old packet agree. Lean induced_degree gives −log210 for the sublattice, hence +log210 for ambient canonical degree.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: The sign/metric convention checks pass at statement/conditional-algebra level; actual Hodge degree must still equal the designated surface height.

obligations.required: Integral extension at every finite place, including 2,3,5,7, and the archimedean norm estimate for the same sections.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: The metric producer derives estimates conditionally on the regular semistable model; MetricSections retains finite_integral and arch_bound.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: Rational Ω frames over Q do not discharge bad-prime integral extension. J²q_i and their valuations need the actual integral model.

obligations.required: Finite branch points, infinity, vertical zeros, level-stack stabilizers and no hidden ramification-line correction.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: Classical notes use q0 vanishing to order two at infinity and q1 nonvanishing; allow common vertical zeros.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: These cases are recorded; whole-intersection identification and gluing of new tensor local sections remain separate unfinished proof work.

obligations.required: Produce MetricSections, then its original/shifted bound, then the literal soundness consumers.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: Exact conditional chain is present and uses t=32u/v.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: No theorem in this lane removes RefinedGeometricRealization. Completion of the source application and a term of that proposition are distinct from its conditional numerical consequences.

applications.claim: Instantiate the actual cusp/Jacobian Arakelov identities for the contribution’s quadratic-log bound.

obligations.required: Smooth projective geometrically connected curve, positive genus, chosen non-Weierstrass point and regular arithmetic model.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: Contribution names the Q-defined modular cover X_H with g≥2 and a selected reciprocal fiber.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: Published theorem hypotheses match that intended setting; the actual cover, selected point and model must be bound to the producer data.

obligations.required: Global orthonormal differentials, their local coefficients, Wronskian, actual regular model and section.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: ActualGlobalCusp constructs the genuine q·j function and derives energy from supplied measures/chart density.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: It does not construct the global orthonormal basis or geometric chart-density identity; these remain fields.

obligations.required: Every complex embedding of the same field and a whole selected fiber avoiding Weierstrass points.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: Data.nonWeierstrass is required for each embedding; embeddingAverage uses [K:Q].
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: The actual geometric selection/count argument must instantiate these fields, not merely pick one complex point.

obligations.required: Use the same cotangent metric and same local coordinate in dπ and Wronskian identities.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: ArakelovIdentifications uses one metricLog in both inequalities with coefficient g(g+1)/2.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: Exact scalar cancellation is checked. The map from the actual Arakelov forms to those logs remains geometric.

obligations.required: hFal must be the height of Jac(X_H) for the same X_H yielding cusp data and finite intersection.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: The record shares D and F parameters but hFal, pointHeight and hGR are real fields.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: A record alone does not identify them with an actual Jacobian and point. Bind the source interpretation before treating jacobian_quadratic as geometric.

obligations.required: Minimal-model ≤ sign, factorial-normalized Wronskian, all-embedding averaging and positive g log√π shift.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: Fresh published PDF checks of Lemma2.3.1, Theorem2.4.1, Lemma2.4.4 agree with the existing code and prior review.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: No sign or shift discrepancy found in this bounded check. No additional half is inserted for complex pairs.

obligations.required: Actual embedded-disc ordinary L² energy, nonzero differential and legitimate logarithmic norms.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: Analytic estimates are proved from holomorphic coefficient data and actual global measure conditions.
obligations.why_match_or_remaining: Need identify these with global L²-normalized forms; Lean log0 convention cannot replace required geometric nonvanishing.

obligations.required: g≥2, non-Weierstrass fiber, all conjugates; auxiliary model field need not have bounded degree.
obligations.constructed_or_proved: Consumer assumptions explicitly contain genus bound, candidate bound, and unrestricted averaging K.

obligations.required: Quadratic-log Jacobian bound feeds 49/8, image/isogeny transfer and contact soundness.

obligations.why_match_or_remaining: This stronger cancellation route is in contribution docs, not the V11 generic Belyi R^19 argument.
